info.name: Nathmandir — Gallery (categories, albums, photos)
info.description:
The छायाचित्रे screen, in the order the app calls it.

  Screen 1  gallery            -> categoryTree, one button per entry
  Screen 2  gallery_category   -> albums[], one card per entry
  Screen 3  (no call)          -> album.photos[], the grid

No Bearer token is needed anywhere in this collection — the gallery is public.

Run the folder top to bottom: request 1 saves the first category key into
{{category}}, so requests 2-4 work with no editing. Every request has tests
asserting the rules the app relies on, so a change that would break the app
fails here first.

Full field-by-field guide: docs/APP_GALLERY_CATEGORIES_API.md

request.description:
SCREEN 1 — the category buttons.

No parameters. No token.

Draw one button per entry in categoryTree, in the order given, printing `name`. Keep `key` — you send it to request 2.

IGNORE `children`. It exists for the website. A subcategory's albums already appear inside the parent on screen 2, so building a screen for it shows the same albums twice.

The top carousel on screen 1 can use the top-level `photos` array from this same response.

`categories`, `albums` and `photos` are what the older APK reads — the new flow does not need them.

request.description:
SCREEN 2 — the album cards.

Draw one card per entry in `albums`, in the order given (newest first — keep it):

    album.title                 <- heading above the image
  +---------------------------+
  |   album.cover             |  <- full-width image
  +---------------------------+
  |   अधिक छायाचित्रे          |  <- your own label, opens screen 3

IGNORE `subcategories` (the website's second chip row) and the top-level `photos` (only for the optional viewer, request 4).

DO NOT FILTER `albums` yourself. An album's own `category` can be a SUBCATEGORY key while you asked for the parent — that is the flattening working. Show exactly what came back.

request.description:
SCREEN 3 — the photo grid.

There is NO API CALL for this screen. This request repeats request 2 only so the tests can prove it: the photos are already inside the card the user tapped.

In the app, hold the response from request 2 and read `album.photos` of the tapped card.

Show `url` in a grid, in the order given (already sorted). `caption` is often empty — do not reserve space for it unconditionally.

An album with no photos uploaded yet gets its cover as the single picture, marked `isCover: true` with `id: null`. That is why the list key must be `key`, never `id`.

request.description:
OPTIONAL — only if you want a full-screen viewer that swipes past the end of one album into the next.

Send the tapped photo's id; open your pager at the TOP-LEVEL `photos[startIndex]`.

`startIndex` is -1 when the photo is not in this category — treat it as 0. It indexes the FULL list, so do not send page/limit with it.

exec: pm.test('message explains it', () => pm.expect(j.message).to.equal('Category not found'));

request.description:
NOTE: the HTTP status is 200; the real status is in the BODY, as with every other operation in this API.

`error` is the STRING "true" / "false", never a boolean. Check `status`, not the type of `error`.
